nextGame.note: Friday night home game at Yulman Stadium. Memphis has won five of its six games. Tulane is calling it Light it Uptown: the first 1,500 fans get light-up glasses, and there is a drone show at halftime and during the game.

news.headline: Tulane has not named a quarterback for Friday
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that the job is open and that Tulane has to play better at quarterback. Three players have taken turns there this season.

news.headline: Tulane's last game is set for November 28
news.summary: The conference picked Saturday, November 28, for Tulane's trip to South Florida. The kickoff time and the TV channel will be announced about two weeks before the game.

news.headline: Army beats Tulane 20-17 on the last play
news.summary: Army kicked a field goal as time ran out at West Point on Saturday. Tulane had tied the game late on a 39-yard touchdown pass from Kadin Semonza to Jaylin Lucas, and hosts Memphis next Friday night.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff in Austin against Texas.

news.headline: Florida may be without its quarterback at Texas
news.summary: Aaron Philo hurt his shoulder in Saturday's loss to South Carolina, and he has done only part of practice this week. If he cannot play Saturday at Texas, Tramell Jones Jr. would start for the first time.

news.headline: Vernell Brown III is practicing again
news.summary: Florida's leading receiver has practiced all week after hurting his knee and missing the last two games. He has a real chance to play Saturday at Texas.

news.headline: Sumrall takes a bigger hand in the defense
news.summary: Jon Sumrall said Monday that he is working with the Florida defense more day to day after South Carolina scored 38 points in Gainesville. He said he is not taking the defense over from Brad White and still has a lot of confidence in that staff.

nextGame.note: Home game against Florida at eleven in the morning.

news.headline: Texas and Ole Miss will start at 6:30
news.summary: The conference set Texas's home game against Ole Miss for Saturday, October 24, at 6:30 in the evening on ABC. It is the second of three straight home games in Austin.

news.headline: Sarkisian defends Arch Manning
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Monday that fans judge Manning harder because of his family name. He said if the name were off the jersey, people would be praising him.

news.headline: Texas loses a star receiver to Florida
news.summary: Easton Royal, a New Orleans high school receiver who had promised to come to Texas, switched to Florida on Sunday. The news came hours after the Longhorns lost to Oklahoma.

nextGame.note: Sunday noon kickoff in New Jersey. The Giants have won three games, lost one and tied one.

news.headline: Tyler Shough is back to full practice
news.summary: The Saints quarterback hurt his left hand in Sunday's loss to Minnesota, and on Wednesday he took part in the whole practice. Receiver Chris Olave stayed out sick, and linebacker Kaden Elliss sat out with a sore calf.

news.headline: Saints let their long snapper go
news.summary: The Saints ended long snapper Cal Adomitis's contract on Tuesday and brought back cornerback Decamerion Richardson. A long snapper handles the ball on every punt and every field goal.

news.headline: Saints owner says 1-4 is not good enough
news.summary: Gayle Benson told a New Orleans club on Tuesday that the Saints' 1-4 start is not acceptable to her. She said the fault starts with her, and that she will make the decisions it takes to make the team better.

tv.name: PSAC Sports Digital Network
tv.note: Every IUP volleyball game is on the PSAC Sports Digital Network. The app is free: search PSAC on a phone, a Roku, an Apple TV or a Fire TV. You can also watch in a browser at psacsportsdigitalnetwork.com/iupathletics.

nextGame.note: Friday night home game at the Kovalchick Complex. Five o'clock our time, six o'clock theirs. Seton Hill has won 10 games and lost 7.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher plays her biggest match of the year
news.summary: Peyton had 7 kills on 18 swings with 4 errors in Tuesday night's five-set win at Wheeling, and she added 2 digs and helped block two balls. She played four of the five sets, and those 7 kills are nearly half her total for the whole season.

news.headline: IUP wins in five sets after losing the first two
news.summary: IUP dropped the first two sets at Wheeling on Tuesday night and then won the last three, 25-23, 25-18 and 15-8. Charlotte Potvin led the way with 23 kills, and the Crimson Hawks are now 15-4 with three wins in a row.

news.headline: Delaney Concannon wins a conference award
news.summary: The outside hitter had 27 digs in two road wins last weekend, including 16 against Gannon, more than anyone on either team. The conference named her its West Division defensive athlete of the week on Monday.

news.headline: Tampa Bay beats the Yankees 4-3 and ends their season
news.summary: Tampa Bay won Wednesday night at Yankee Stadium to take the series three games to none. The Yankees are out of the playoffs, and it is 17 years since they last won the World Series.

news.headline: A fan reaches over the wall and takes away a home run
news.summary: Anthony Volpe hit a ball to left field in the sixth inning that would have tied the game at 4-4. A fan leaned over the wall and caught it, so the umpires gave Volpe a double instead and only one run scored.

news.headline: Aaron Judge says the Yankees should go all in
news.summary: Judge strained a calf in September and watched the whole playoff series from the dugout. He said afterward that the team should go all in and add players for next year.

nextGame.venue: Joe Yenni Stadium, East Jefferson High School
nextGame.note: Thursday night road game in Metairie, and a district game. Warren Easton has won two in a row. East Jefferson has won one game and lost five.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins again, 29-6 over Higgins
news.summary: The Eagles beat L.W. Higgins on Thursday night at Pan American Stadium for their second win in a row. Their defense has given up only six points in those two games.

news.headline: Warren Easton wins its first game, 50-0
news.summary: The Eagles shut out Riverdale 50-0 on Thursday in Jefferson for their first win of the year. Warren Easton is now 1-4.

news.headline: Warren Easton loses at Zachary
news.summary: Zachary won 49-28 on Friday night. Warren Easton is 0-4 and plays at Riverdale on Thursday, October 1.
